mapper.insert: INSERT INTO connected_institution (connected_account_id, institution_code, status) VALUES (#{connectedAccountId}, #{institutionCode}, 'ACTIVE')
mapper.select: SELECT ci.institution_code, i.name, i.business_type, ci.created_at FROM connected_institution ci JOIN institution i ON ci.institution_code = i.code WHERE ci.connected_account_id = #{connectedAccountId} ORDER BY ci.created_at
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected_institution WHERE connected_account_id = #{connectedAccountId}
